objectives.title: Read the flag
objectives.prompt: Exploit the http method tampering weakness of a PHP page of the Springfield Nuclear Power Plant protected by an HTTP login prompt and recover the flag (FLAG{...}) it guards.
hints: Check which HTTP methods the protection actually covers.
Look at which values the login flow trusts from the client.

steps.title: Identify the stack
steps.prompt: Which framework or language runs the application? (name only)

steps.title: Name the weakness
steps.prompt: Which class of bypass changes the HTTP method a protected page receives?

steps.title: Identify the protection
steps.prompt: Which kind of HTTP authentication prompt protects the page?

steps.title: Name the second weakness
steps.prompt: Which kind of flaw lets you bypass the check without breaking any crypto or injecting anything?
